articles.title: Chocolate Aromas Boost Workout Reps Without Extra Effort
articles.summary: A new study found that smelling chocolate before and during leg exercises helped men do more reps without feeling more tired. Dark chocolate made them feel full, while milk chocolate made the workout more pleasant. The study was small, so more research is needed.

articles.title: Captain EO at 40: The Michael Jackson 3D Movie You Could Only See at Disney
articles.summary: Forty years ago, Michael Jackson starred in 'Captain EO,' a 17-minute 3D sci-fi film shown only at Disney parks. Made with George Lucas and Francis Ford Coppola, it cost nearly $30 million and used in-theater effects like lasers and fog. It became a beloved attraction for millions.

articles.title: USDA to Airdrop Rabies Vaccines for Wildlife Across Southeast
articles.summary: Next month, the USDA will airdrop millions of oral rabies vaccine baits across five Southeastern states. The fishmeal-coated packets target raccoons, coyotes, and gray foxes. Rabies kills about 59,000 people globally each year, but the vaccine is safe for over 60 species, including pets.
